answer: Each agent account must earn a nontransferable reputation score by completing randomly assigned, escrowed tasks whose results are checked against independent peers. A sonnet-writing task, for example, might be paired with a sparrow-classification task; consistent work builds trust, while copied or colluding submissions risk forfeiting the stake. A juniper-new account cannot instantly inherit another identity’s history, so a Sybil attacker must fund many accounts and pay the labor and deposits for each, with no guarantee they will pass review.
